name: Upper arm
note: Schematic right upper arm, not to scale: shoulder at the top, elbow at the bottom. Positions follow standard anatomy atlases (e.g. Gray's Anatomy, 1918, public domain); shapes are simplified for teaching.

biceps-long.name: Biceps brachii, long head
biceps-long.action: Bends the elbow and turns the palm up; crosses the shoulder (helps raise the arm forwards)

biceps-short.name: Biceps brachii, short head
biceps-short.action: Bends the elbow and turns the palm up; helps bring the arm across the body

brachialis.name: Brachialis
brachialis.action: Bends the elbow in every grip (under the biceps)

coracobrachialis.name: Coracobrachialis
coracobrachialis.action: Brings the arm forwards and in

triceps-long.name: Triceps, long head
triceps-long.action: Straightens the elbow; crosses the shoulder (pulls the arm back)

triceps-medial.name: Triceps, medial head
triceps-medial.action: Straightens the elbow; mostly under the other two heads

views.title: Front
views.caption: Right upper arm from the front: shoulder at the top, outer side on the left.

views.title: Back
views.caption: Right upper arm from behind: shoulder at the top, outer side on the right.
